personas.demographic_context: Early 30s, works full-time, runs a few times per week and does occasional races. Often buys after seeing ads on social media.
personas.primary_motivation: Stay fit and injury-free with reliable running shoes.
personas.cognitive_style: Balanced; reads a mix of specs and user reviews.
buying_barriers: Worry shoes won’t last or will cause pain

personas.label: Value-First Family Planner
personas.demographic_context: Mid 30s to 40s, parent of school-age kids, juggles busy schedule. Frequently reads product reviews.
personas.primary_motivation: Buy shoes that last and feel good without straining the budget.
personas.cognitive_style: Practical; checks price, durability, and comfort guarantees.

personas.label: Drop-Hunting Sneakerhead
personas.demographic_context: Late teens to late 20s, follows sneaker news and social media closely. Sticks with brands that deliver good experiences.
personas.primary_motivation: Get unique or limited sneakers that signal taste and status.
personas.cognitive_style: Fast, emotion-driven; scans visuals, story, and scarcity cues.

personas.label: Weekend Trail Explorer
personas.demographic_context: Late 20s to 40s, works weekdays, spends some weekends hiking. Prefers online shopping to in-store visits.
personas.primary_motivation: Stay safe and comfortable on trails without overbuying heavy gear.
personas.cognitive_style: Scenario-driven; imagines specific trail conditions.

personas.label: Shift-Weary Server
personas.demographic_context: 20s to 40s, works long shifts in restaurants or cafes. Often buys after seeing ads on social media.
personas.primary_motivation: End shifts with less foot and back pain.
personas.cognitive_style: Empathy-driven; listens to stories from people like them.
buying_barriers: Shoes that only feel good for first hour

personas.label: Instagram-Aware Tastemaker
personas.demographic_context: Mid 20s, lives in a stylish neighborhood, active on social platforms. Frequently reads product reviews.
personas.primary_motivation: Curate looks that photograph well and feel unique.
personas.cognitive_style: Visual-first; cares more about look and story than technical detail.

personas.label: Conscious Capsule Wardrober
personas.demographic_context: Early 30s to mid 40s, cares about sustainability and minimalism. Often buys after seeing ads on social media.
personas.primary_motivation: Own fewer shoes that are versatile, durable, and ethically made.
personas.cognitive_style: Reflective; reads details about materials and lifecycle.

personas.label: Active Grandparent Walker
personas.demographic_context: 60s, retired or part-time, walks daily for health. Prefers online shopping to in-store visits.
personas.primary_motivation: Stay mobile and comfortable to keep up with life and family.
personas.cognitive_style: Careful; reads key sections and reassurance text.

personas.label: Injury-Recovery Planner
personas.demographic_context: 30s to 50s, has had foot or knee issues, advised to wear better shoes. Prefers online shopping to in-store visits.
personas.primary_motivation: Avoid re-injury and manage pain through better footwear.
personas.cognitive_style: Evidence-seeking; cares about expert input and clear design rationale.

personas.label: Urban Desk-to-Dinner Professional
personas.demographic_context: Late 20s to mid 30s, works in a downtown office, often goes out after work. Sticks with brands that deliver good experiences.
personas.primary_motivation: Have one pair of shoes that works for the office, commute, and social evenings.
personas.cognitive_style: Skims headlines and benefits, then checks a few details if interested.
buying_barriers: Shoes looking too casual for office
